translations.title: Multivitamin and Mineral Soft Capsule — Vitamin E and B group + Magnesium and Zinc (no Vitamin A or Iron)
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2 and B6 in physical fatigue, reduced stamina and old age; for peripheral circulation problems and cold hands and feet; for neuralgia and muscle pain; to relieve angular cheilitis and mouth sores; to supply zinc; and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
translations.usage: Adults and children aged 12 and over take one capsule twice a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive to soybean oil, soya or peanuts, if you are a baby under 12 months, or if you have severe kidney failure. If you take an estrogen-containing contraceptive or are prone to blood clots, taking vitamin E may increase the risk of clots, so seek advice.
